verdict: Organic signals are softening across all three entities this period.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, all inbound activity this period came entirely from Google Business Profile and organic search — no paid channels were active. Combined, your three profiles generated 405 GBP actions (calls, direction requests, and website clicks) over the last 28 days, but engagement dropped meaningfully in the final week, with GBP actions down 29–39% week-over-week across all entities and the last three days showing near-zero activity. Organic search held better at Advance Grinding, where search clicks rose 14% week-over-week, but O'Hare saw a 25% drop and Forte's search clicks fell 60% in the same comparison. Several CRM, outreach, and web milestones that were due as far back as July are being resolved this month, and reactivating outreach sequences and reindexing all three sites are the moves in progress that will directly address the visibility softness you're seeing now.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three entities in the last 28 days (calls, direction requests, and website clicks)
average GBP week-over-week decline across Forte, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare — a consistent dip, not an isolated event
organic search clicks to O'Hare alone this period, the strongest search footprint across all three entities

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement stalled to near-zero across all three profiles in the last three days of the period, coinciding with declining search impressions — a confirmed softening, not noise.
watch_item.fix: Site reindexing is underway for all three brands and lapsed outreach sequences are being launched this week, both of which are designed to rebuild search visibility and direct engagement heading into November.
